title: Discovery of TCR-like antibodies to the KRAS G12D neoantigen via in silico-in vitro workflow
one_line: A hybrid ProteinMPNN-guided design plus yeast-display selection workflow produced TCR-like antibodies specific for the KRAS G12D 10-mer presented on HLA-C*08:02, reformatted into CAR-T and bispecific T-cell engager formats.
key_claims: Constrained CDR loop-tip redesign by ProteinMPNN on docked human variable fragments yielded nine top designs that seeded a yeast surface-display library, giving initial hit C8K10D at KD ~1.36 µM.

Affinity maturation improved binding ~70-fold to 17.4 nM (variant C8K10D5), and solubility engineering (variants DQE, DE) removed hydrophobic aggregation patches, raising yield and further improving affinity to 2.38 nM.

Negative selection against non-pulsed cells and cells pulsed with a SARS-CoV-2 peptide removed cross-reactive clones (variants C8K10D51, NAGF18); phage-display specificity profiling showed no human off-target reactivity and in silico analysis predicted low immunogenicity.
X-ray crystallography at 4.5 Å showed the antibody reaches into the peptide groove and contacts the mutant aspartate at position 3 and lysine at position 7, discriminating against G12V and G12C.
The same targeting head as CAR-T or as a bispecific SCDB engager drove dose-dependent, selective killing of KRAS G12D-positive cells with no detectable killing of wild-type KRAS cells.
limitations: All cytotoxicity data are cell-based in vitro assays; in vivo efficacy and safety were not demonstrated.
AlphaFold2 failed to accurately predict the binding interface, so computational design alone could not validate the structure.
Crystallographic resolution was limited to 4.5 Å.
Targeting is restricted to the HLA-C*08:02 allele, limiting the eligible patient population.
Early lead showed weak binding to cells displaying a SARS-CoV-2 peptide, indicating affinity maturation can introduce off-target risk that required extra sorting.
open_questions: Does either format show efficacy and tolerable safety in vivo in KRAS G12D tumor models?
Will peptide-level selectivity hold against a full endogenous peptidome rather than pulsed-peptide and phage-display panels?
Is the workflow generalizable to other neoantigen/HLA allele pairs beyond KRAS G12D/HLA-C*08:02?
Would higher-resolution structures explain why solubility substitutions also increased affinity?
